instances._review_comment: Replaces beans-sources.json (owner, 2026-10-20: "if we did a KG, then we could just list those as remote KGs to review"). Left out because they declare no beans directory: bootstrap, bootstrap-tools, folio-assistant-sci, fhir-harness, who-iris. folio-assistant is an index, not an instance; its beans arrive through cat-harness. qou is never mounted (owner, 2026-10-20).

remote.note: Reviewed for its work plan only (beans). Also holds folio-assistant's beans: folio-assistant keeps them on cat/cat-harness/beans.

consent.evidence: Owner litlfred, 2026-10-20, answering "Record your trust consent for the five remote KGs to review?" in a Claude Code session: "Approve all five". Pinned to each repository's main at that time, for its beans directory only.
